info.title: Veil
info.description: Agent credential broker. Use injects the secret at the edge. Responses never include vault material. CLI, MCP, and generated SDKs are projections of this contract.

tags.name: Agent
tags.description: Bearer is the agent. listItems is metadata. useItem injects. Never GetSecret.

tags.name: Owner
tags.description: Bearer is a Keto member human. Create items and grants. Secret may be sent, never returned.

tags.name: Human
tags.description: Bearer is a verified human ID token. Pre-membership — provision creates the membership.

get.summary: Liveness. No secrets.
This contract.
Items this principal may see. Agent: granted. Human owner: the org. Human member: granted. Names and URIs. Never secrets.

post.summary: Create an item. Secret is in the request over TLS. Never in the response. Not MCP.
One-shot 1Password .1pux or CSV onto origin. Secret in the file, never in the response. Not MCP.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: export.1pux or chrome.csv. Sniffed from bytes when empty.

patch.summary: Replace URIs, tags, and fill username. No secret.

delete.summary: Remove the item and its grants. Not MCP.

post.summary: Hide from Use and list. History stays.

get.summary: Grants in this org. No secrets. Not MCP.

post.summary: Grant an agent or a Kratos human Use on an item. Same grant object. Not MCP. Not a family vault.

get.summary: Org groups. A grant to a group is the shared vault. Not MCP.

post.summary: Create an org group. Not MCP.

get.summary: Members of the group — agent or human edges. Not MCP.

post.summary: Add an agent or human to the group. Not MCP.

delete.summary: Remove a member from the group. Not MCP.

get.summary: Agents in this org. Ids only. Never secrets. Not MCP.

post.summary: Register an agent principal. Not a Hydra secret. Not MCP.
Revoke an agent. Idempotent. Kills grants, sessions, and in-flight Use. Record stays for audit.

200.description: Revoked agent. No token or secret.

get.summary: Active sandbox sessions. Metadata only. Never the token. Not MCP.

post.summary: Mint a short-lived Use lease onto an existing agent. Token is in this response once. Sandbox gets the session file, not the agent JWT. Default 15m, max 1h. Not MCP.
Call a URL as this agent. The broker injects the credential. The vault secret is never in the response.

get.summary: Approval requests filed by level-1 agents. status=open lists only unexpired asks. Not MCP.
Server-sent events feed of approval-request changes for the owner org. Each event is an empty tick — refetch GET /v1/requests for the authoritative rows. Not MCP.

200.description: text/event-stream; stays open until the client disconnects

post.summary: Approve an open request — unlocks its level-1 grant for ttl. First write wins.

404.description: no such request in this org

post.summary: Deny an open request. First write wins; the agent's next use files a fresh ask.

404.description: no such request in this org

get.summary: This agent's grant events. Decision, item, action. Never secrets. Not MCP.

200.description: Recent events for the Bearer agent

get.summary: Vault health report — weak, reused, optionally breached passwords across items the human can see. Metadata only; never secrets. hibp=1 opts into k-anonymity breach lookup.

parameters.name: hibp
parameters.description: Opt into HaveIBeenPwned k-anonymity breach counts (5-char SHA-1 prefix only).

200.description: Health report for the Bearer human's visible items

post.summary: Signup provisioning. Subject-authenticated — the bearer is a verified human ID token, not a member yet. Creates the org, seals the org master under the deployment KEK, plants the humans row, and writes the Keto owner/member tuples plus the Kratos organization_id stamp. Idempotent; safe to retry. Not MCP.

Private-alpha invite. Owner-authenticated — the bearer is a verified human ID token of a provisioned human. Creates the Kratos identity plus recovery link under the inviter's org and emails the setup link via the mail worker. recovery_url only appears when mail is not configured (local dev). Idempotent for re-invites. Not MCP.

delete.summary: Offboard a member. Owner-only — drops the Keto member tuple and the humans row; the removed member's token resolves nothing from that call on. Owners cannot be removed this way (demote first). Not MCP.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Kratos identity id of the member

403.description: caller is a member, not an owner

404.description: not a member of this org

post.summary: Grant an existing member the owners tuple. Owner-only. Not MCP.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Kratos identity id of the member

403.description: caller is a member, not an owner

404.description: not a member of this org

delete.summary: Strip the owners tuple from a co-owner. Owner-only. The last owner cannot be demoted — the org would have no administrator. Not MCP.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Kratos identity id of the owner

403.description: caller is a member, not an owner

404.description: not an owner of this org

delete.summary: Leave the org: drops the member (and owner, when present) tuples plus the humans row — the token resolves nothing afterward. A sole owner is refused: promote a member or delete the org. Not MCP.

Teardown. Owner-only. Deletes every Keto tuple for the org, then purges every vault row (items, grants, sessions, agents, humans, keys) in one transaction. Audit rows are kept — teardown must not erase the forensic record. Not MCP.

403.description: caller is a member, not an owner

get.summary: Owner-facing billing state: enforced plan plus this window's use count against the free allowance. included is null when metering is off or the plan is paid. The vault's cap banner reads this. Not MCP.

post.summary: Vortex billing webhook receiver. Auth is the Vortex-Signature header (HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body) — no org principal. Subscription and entitlement lifecycle events flip the org's plan state; unknown event types are durable no-ops. Not MCP.

get.summary: Committed audit feed for this owner’s org — the customer SIEM pull. Keyset-paginated: poll with ?after=<next_after> until a short page lands. Events queued in the outbox join the feed on relay. Owner-only. Not MCP.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Resume cursor — return committed events with id > after.

200.description: One page of committed org audit events

post.summary: Owner-only upgrade click: mints a fresh hosted Vortex checkout URL bound to this org. Checkout tokens are single-use and hash-pinned — never cache the URL; mint one per click. The vault's cap-banner Subscribe action. Not MCP.

Register a push endpoint for the caller's org. The phone app POSTs its APNs/FCM token on sign-in and refresh. Humans only — an agent must never mint a wake channel for asks meant to reach a human. Idempotent upsert.

400.description: platform must be apns or fcm and token is required

delete.summary: Drop a push token — sign-out and token rotation land here. Idempotent: an absent token is already unregistered.

post.summary: Rotate an item's credential via the provider's key-management API. The new secret is verified and sealed in place — item id and grants are untouched, agents keep calling Use. Owner-only. 422 when the provider has no rotator.
Bind an existing agent to an external OIDC issuer, subject, and audience (workload identity federation). Owner-only — binding an auth method to an agent is a grant-adjacent write.
Dry-run OIDC discovery against an issuer URL before saving a workload binding. Owner-only — never mounted on /mcp.

get.summary: List bound OIDC workload policies for an agent. Owner-only.

delete.summary: Remove an OIDC workload binding from an agent. Owner-only.

get.summary: List zero-touch rotation provider hosts and assisted rotation capability. Owner-only.

post.summary: Dry-run an item's credential (outbound WIF exchange, OAuth refresh, or provider rotator verify) without revealing the secret. Owner-only.

get.summary: List an item's post-rotation fan-outs. Owner only — hook URLs may embed capability tokens.

put.summary: Replace an item's post-rotation fan-out list. Each webhook gets rotation metadata (item, rotated_at, key version) — never the secret.

post.summary: Re-send the rotation notification to each configured consumer without rotating — the retry after a consumer outage. Each firing is audited rotation_hook_fired.

get.summary: The caller's own recovery-share state: enrolled flag, pubkey, and wrapped_master (ciphertext only — never the plaintext master).

post.summary: Initial recovery-share enrollment (aal2). Insert-if-absent: a member's pubkey never rotates outside the ceremony, so an existing share is a 409.

403.description: aal1 token — enrollment requires a second factor

post.summary: Files (or returns the existing open) recovery request. Self-start needs no aal2 — a locked-out member may hold only aal1. Owner-initiated starts (human_id set) require aal2 + owner. One open request per member: a refile returns the live row with created=false and suppresses duplicate notifications.

400.description: malformed new_pubkey or a pubkey already enrolled on a share

403.description: non-owner naming another human, or aal1 owner-initiated start

404.description: named human is not an org member

get.summary: Owner-only (aal2) list of org recovery requests filtered by status.
One request. Owners (aal2) get the confirmer view — human_email, current_epoch, confirmer_wrapped_master; the initiator or target member gets the bare row.

403.description: not owner, initiator, or target — or aal1 owner

404.description: no such request in this org

post.summary: The confirmer's commit (owner, aal2): rotates the org master, re-wraps every member share and owner DEK, moves the member's share to the staged pubkey at epoch+1, and fires the Kratos MFA reset when reset_mfa was filed. Multi-owner orgs enforce two-person integrity. proof_hmac bypasses the sole-owner timelock. The MFA reset code never rides the response.

403.description: not owner, aal1, or two-person integrity violation

404.description: no such request, or target was offboarded

post.summary: Resolve an open request: an owner denies (aal2); the initiator or target member cancels at any aal. First write wins.

403.description: not owner, initiator, or target — or aal1 owner

404.description: no such request in this org

bearerAuth.description: Hydra JWT. Identity is the bound agent or a Keto member human. The host is not identity.

login.description: Fill username. Metadata. Not a secret. Empty if unset.

url.description: Absolute URL. Host must match the item.

headers.description: Extra request headers. Never the vault secret.

body.description: Request body. Never the vault secret. Use --body-file on the CLI.

body_b64.description: Base64 request body for binary payloads. Takes precedence over body. Never the vault secret.

request_id.description: The filed approval request when decision is need_approval. Owners resolve it via /v1/requests/{id}.

request_expires_at.description: When the filed ask dies unanswered. Agents may keep retrying until then.

headers.description: Upstream response headers, including Content-Type and Content-Encoding.

body.description: Upstream body with vault secrets scrubbed. Present when the body is valid UTF-8.

body_b64.description: Base64 upstream body with vault secrets scrubbed. Present when the body is not valid UTF-8 (gzip, images, protobuf).

secret.description: Vault material. Request only. Never returned.

totp_seed.description: TOTP seed. Request only. Never returned.

login.description: Fill username. Metadata on the item. Also sealed in the envelope. Not a secret.

uri.description: Add this autofill host. Does not drop existing hosts.

uris.description: Replace autofill hosts with this list.

login.description: Fill username. Metadata on the item. Also sealed in the envelope.

secret.description: Rotate the sealed secret — a changed password. TOTP seed, login, and passkey survive. Blank refuses; absent leaves the secret alone.

human.description: Kratos identity id. Same Grant.agent_id. Not email. XOR agent/group.

group.description: Org group name — the shared vault. XOR agent/human.

subject_kind.description: Subject kind. agent_id holds the subject id — the group id when subject_kind is group.

revoked_at.description: Set when the agent is revoked. Record stays for audit.

Session.description: Sandbox Use lease metadata. Never the token.

uses.description: Use calls that passed authorization and reached upstream consumption.

CreateSessionResponse.description: Token is create-only. Never list. Never MCP.

uses.description: Use calls that passed authorization and reached upstream consumption.

CardFields.description: Request only. Never returned. Never MCP.

IdentityFields.description: Request only. Never returned. Never MCP.

recovery_url.description: Only present when mail delivery is not configured (local dev).

resolved_by.description: The Kratos identity of the owner who answered — first write wins.

approval_id.description: The grant approval created by an approve resolution.

ttl.description: Go duration for the grant approval lifetime (default 15m).

plan.description: Plan as enforced by the Use gate

used.description: Uses consumed in the current window

included.description: Free allowance per window; null when unlimited (metering off or paid plan)

upgrade_url.description: Vortex checkout/portal link for capped owners

id.description: Committed row id — monotonically increasing per append; the feed cursor.

next_after.description: Cursor for the next page — pass as ?after=. Equals the last event id, or the requested cursor when the page is empty.

checkout_url.description: Fresh hosted Vortex checkout URL for this org — navigate immediately, single-use

member_id.description: Agent id, or Kratos identity id for humans.

claims.description: optional OidcPolicy claim rules (every key must match at least one allowed value)
optional OidcPolicy claim rules (every key must match at least one allowed value)

management_item.description: separate vault item holding the provider management credential

name.description: consumer label for audit, e.g. ci-resecrets

url.description: consumer endpoint; a capability token may ride in path/query — sealed, never in audit

RecoveryShare.description: The member's own org-key share state (VEIL-78). pubkey and wrapped_master are ciphertext material only — the 32-byte X25519 public key (base64) and the 80-byte box.SealAnonymous blob (base64). The private key and the plaintext org master never leave the client/store.

enrolled.description: Whether the member has an org_key_shares row.

wrapped_master.description: 80-byte box.SealAnonymous ciphertext of the org master, base64.

wrap_pubkey_epoch.description: Share wrap epoch; bumps on every completed recovery.

org_key_version.description: Org master version the share wraps.

RecoveryRequest.description: One initiator -> confirmer recovery ceremony row (VEIL-78). Owner callers also see human_email, current_epoch, and confirmer_wrapped_master (the caller's own share blob for the proof_hmac fast path); the initiator/target member sees the bare row.

initiated_by.description: Who filed the request — the member (self) or an owner.

reset_mfa.description: On completion, wipe the member's Kratos totp/webauthn and mail a re-enrollment link to their address.

unlock_at.description: Immediate for owner-confirmed paths; created_at+24h for sole-owner self-recovery.

result_epoch.description: The member's new wrap_pubkey_epoch after completion.

human_email.description: Owner view only — the member's resolved Kratos address.

current_epoch.description: Owner view only — the member's current wrap_pubkey_epoch.

confirmer_wrapped_master.description: Owner view only — the caller's own wrapped share (80B base64) for computing proof_hmac locally.

pubkey.description: Member's 32-byte X25519 public key, base64 or hex.

human_id.description: Omit for self-recovery; set for owner-initiated recovery of a member.

new_pubkey.description: Staged 32-byte X25519 public key, base64 or hex. Must not match any enrolled share pubkey.

reset_mfa.description: Also wipe the member's Kratos second factors on completion.

proof_hmac.description: hex(HMAC-SHA256(org master, request id)) — the sole-owner fast path that bypasses the 24h timelock.

created.description: false means an open request already existed — the live row is returned and notifications were suppressed.

recovery_pubkey.description: Optional 32-byte X25519 public key (base64 or hex) to enroll the member's recovery share at signup.
